correctness.rationale: Exact ancestor probability 1/t; independence from earlier parent choices; local conditional depth difference 1+H_{j-1}-H_{t-1}; partial summation gives the exact covariance. value.rationale: The newest vertex depth and an individual earlier vertex’s outdegree are natural competing local observables in recursive growth. The exact finite dependence profile reveals a sharp sign reversal at label sqrt(n/2) and a lattice-scale correction not available from marginal limits or general joint first-order distributions; it is an infinite, structurally motivated classification, not a small numerical gain.
